experience.title: Future Games Warsaw
experience.text: Worked on team-based game development projects using a full production pipeline from prototype to release while collaborating from teams around the world.
highlights: Followed complete game development lifecycle: prototype, iteration, playtesting, polish, and release.
Used Jira for sprint planning, task tracking, and milestone delivery.
Used Perforce for source control, asset sync, and team collaboration across disciplines.

experience.title: Gnome Splash - Local Multiplayer PvP
experience.text: Led gameplay programming for a split-screen PvP prototype with a focus on complete match flow and shippable gameplay loops.
highlights: Implemented up to 4-player gameplay systems including spawning, damage handling, respawn logic, and round flow.
Built HUD and UI features for readable gameplay, including health, cooldowns, menus, and match transitions.
Delivered a playable build from prototype to final in a structured 7-week production cycle with rapid iteration and testing.

experience.title: Secrets of the Mansion
experience.text: Created a story-driven exploration prototype with scene progression, puzzle logic, and event triggers.
highlights: Designed and implemented key UI systems with a focus on clarity and responsiveness.
Supported gameplay implementation by wiring UI elements to game state and refining interactions through playtesting feedback.
Collaborated in a 10 to 20 person team using Jira for sprint planning, task tracking, and milestone delivery.
Contributed to an immersive, narrative-first experience by prioritizing usability and smooth player flow.

experience.title: TomTheDragon
experience.text: Contributed to a team-built 3D platformer focused on clear progression, responsive controls, and a polished player flow from level start to win condition.
highlights: Implemented player movement logic to ensure responsive, readable controls and a consistent platforming feel.
Built additional gameplay elements to enhance immersion and supported integration through playtesting-driven refinement.
Supported power-up and obstacle loops, including collectible buffs and hazard interactions, to strengthen pacing and challenge.

experience.title: Molten Engine

highlights: Designed clear module boundaries to keep systems testable and maintainable.
Integrated ImGui-based editor tooling to inspect runtime state and speed up iteration during development.
Maintain a clean CMake project structure to support scalability, rebuild speed, and portability.

projectExperience.title: TG360 - Travel Guardian 360
projectExperience.meta: C++17 | Cpp-httplib | nlohmann::json | SSE | Dijkstra | FastAPI
projectExperience.text: Led a 5-person HackYeah team and shipped a working real-time transit disruption demo from concept to live presentation.
highlights: Built a C++17 backend with clear JSON endpoints for routing, incident reporting, prediction, and live client updates.
Implemented graph-based shortest-path routing and recomputed ETAs when incidents changed travel-time weights.
Streamed real-time updates using Server-Sent Events to keep the UI synced without polling.
Applied modern C++ concurrency with threads, mutexes, and condition variables to keep shared state safe and responsive.
Debugged and fixed a critical SSE lifetime and concurrency crash, then validated reliability with curl and PowerShell tests.
